steps.intent: Close the MFA alert: Brandt said yes

steps.tell: 10 denied prompts, then 1 yes, from a device never seen before.

evidence.label: MFA alert
evidence.detail: 2:14 AM: K. Brandt, Director of Research, approved an MFA prompt. Patch's confidence it's fine: 91%.

evidence.label: Patch's reason
evidence.detail: "He tapped yes. So it was him! Case closed."

evidence.label: MFA log
evidence.detail: 2:02 to 2:14 AM: 11 prompts on Brandt's account. 10 denied, then 1 approved.

evidence.label: Sign-in log
evidence.detail: The sign-in after that yes came from a device never seen before, in another country.

outcome.executed: The alert closes. The stranger keeps Brandt's session all night. By 8 AM, 3 months of client research is copied out.
outcome.blocked: You keep it open. Someone sent prompts until Brandt gave up. Now the team can end that sign-in.

outcome.rolledBack: You reopen the alert at 2:50 AM and end the stranger's session. They had 36 minutes in Brandt's mailbox.

steps.lesson: Check who's asking. One yes after many no's is not a real yes. Read the MFA log and the device, not just the approval.

steps.intent: Sign K. Brandt out and reset his password

evidence.detail: MFA attack: sign the user out everywhere and reset the password.

evidence.label: What it will change
evidence.detail: Ends all of Brandt's sessions. He gets a temporary password. He picks a new one at 8 AM.

outcome.executed: The stranger's session ends at 2:31 AM. Brandt goes back to sleep. At 8 AM, he picks a new password.
outcome.blocked: Nothing changes. The stranger stays signed in as Brandt and keeps reading his mail.
outcome.escalated: Kofi reads the callback note. "Brandt confirmed it, and PB-04 says sign out and reset. That one can go."

steps.lesson: Check who's asking with a callback to the phone on file. After a confirmed MFA attack, sign out and reset. It sounds harsh. It's right.

evidence.detail: Removes only the phone added at 2:15 AM. Brandt's own phone stays. It can be added back.

outcome.blocked: The attacker's phone stays on Brandt's MFA. With it, they could reset his new password and get back in.

outcome.rolledBack: You put the unknown phone back on Brandt's MFA. Kofi removes it again and writes it in his notebook.

outcome.executed: Payroll stops halfway. 240 drivers don't get paid today. Mensah calls Fenwick. Twice.
outcome.blocked: The server stays online. The approved update finishes at 4:24 PM. 240 drivers get paid on time.
outcome.escalated: Kofi checks the calendar. "Approved update, payroll running, no OK from the client. Contain the threat, not the business."
outcome.rolledBack: You reconnect the server. Payroll has to start over. Drivers get paid 3 hours late. Mensah is not happy.

steps.lesson: Change safely. Check the calendar and what the server does before you isolate it. The right action at the wrong time hurts the business.
